001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Part of the burst of records 488-497 the Tandem Mobi writes every two hours. Each covers the two
009 * hours since the previous burst; the counts below were compared with the requests TandemKit
010 * logged in 161 such windows on two pumps (the maintainer's and a tester's).
011 *
012 * The class name is provisional: opcode 491 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
013 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
014 */
015@HistoryLogProps(
016    opCode = 491,
017    displayName = "History Request Range"
018)
019public class HistoryRequestRangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
020
021    private long unknown10;
022    private long minStartLog;
023    private long maxStartLog;
024    private int unknown22;
025    private int unknown24;
026
027    public HistoryRequestRangeHistoryLog() {}
028    public HistoryRequestRangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long unknown10, long minStartLog, long maxStartLog, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
029        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, unknown10, minStartLog, maxStartLog, unknown22, unknown24);
031        this.unknown10 = unknown10;
032        this.minStartLog = minStartLog;
033        this.maxStartLog = maxStartLog;
034        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
035        this.unknown24 = unknown24;
036    }
037
038    public int typeId() {
039        return 491;
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * <table border="1">
044     * <caption>Parsed fields for HistoryRequestRangeHistoryLog:</caption>
045     * <tr><td><code>unknown10</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
046     * <tr><td><code>minStartLog</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
047     * <tr><td><code>maxStartLog</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
048     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
049     * <tr><td><code>unknown24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
050     * </table>
051     */
052    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
053        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
054        this.cargo = raw;
055        parseBase(raw);
056        this.unknown10 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
057        this.minStartLog = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
058        this.maxStartLog = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
059        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
060        this.unknown24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
061    }
062
063    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long unknown10, long minStartLog, long maxStartLog, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
064        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
065            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(491, 0),
066            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
067            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
068            Bytes.toUint32(unknown10),
069            Bytes.toUint32(minStartLog),
070            Bytes.toUint32(maxStartLog),
071            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown22),
072            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown24)));
073    }
074
075    /**
076     * Not the number of records the phone received: a median of 2.6 times that count
077     * (0.97 to 431 times) in 158 windows. It correlates with the amount of history streamed.
078     *
079     * @return raw uint32 at offset 10
080     */
081    public long getUnknown10() {
082        return unknown10;
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Equal to the lowest HistoryLogRequest startLog in the window in 161 of 161 windows.
087     *
088     * @return lowest requested startLog
089     */
090    public long getMinStartLog() {
091        return minStartLog;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * Equal to the highest HistoryLogRequest startLog in the window in 161 of 161 windows.
096     *
097     * @return highest requested startLog
098     */
099    public long getMaxStartLog() {
100        return maxStartLog;
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * 0 in every record.
105     *
106     * @return raw uint16 at offset 22
107     */
108    public int getUnknown22() {
109        return unknown22;
110    }
111
112    /**
113     * Usually 1 to 4 below the number of HistoryLogRequests in the window (141 of 161
114     * windows), equal in 1, and up to 25 below in windows with large backfills.
115     *
116     * @return raw uint16 at offset 24
117     */
118    public int getUnknown24() {
119        return unknown24;
120    }
121}
